name: half-wired-identity-only-substrate-fuses-like-none
description: A server holding the record store and nothing else can restore no render, so it is as substrate-less as one holding nothing. This is where the fusion is easiest to get wrong: the re-mint is consulted only when the row is absent, so a verdict derived from a partial substrate check answers NOT_FOUND for a row that exists and NOT_SUPPORTED for one that never did — the existence oracle, rebuilt out of a provisioning mistake.
